Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1167
Claimant:
Terri Miller
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
10-23-23
Insured driver reported a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road. Claimant is listed as a passenger and
is now represented by counsel, who has submitted a bodily injury demand alleging a wrist fracture.
11-11-23
Reviewed the police report and the photos taken at the scene. The vehicle damage is consistent with the described
impact, and a few older scratches on the panel may predate this loss.
11-27-23
The responding officer and two independent drivers who stopped at the scene both state that the claimant was not
inside the vehicle when the collision occurred. Statements have been requested to clarify this point.
12-5-23
Confirmed the insured is named on the policy and found nothing indicating the damage happened before coverage
began. Coverage position remains under review pending the bodily injury evaluation.
1-17-24
Claimant's account of the collision has been consistent in every contact so far, including the initial call and the
recorded statement. Counsel has provided the medical records for the wrist.
1-25-24
The medical records show a fracture diagnosis, but the impact described appears very light for injury of this severity.
Requested the imaging and any prior records for the wrist and surrounding area.
2-9-24
Prior records show a minor strain in the same area several years ago that healed fully with no lasting limitation.
Treatment after this loss followed a typical course and tapered off as the claimant improved.
2-22-24
No independent eyewitnesses have come forward, and the scene photos confirm some of the reported details without
settling the question of how the injury occurred. Referred the file for a medical records review.
3-25-24
Sent the reviewer's summary to counsel requesting a response to the outstanding questions about the claimant's
location at impact and the prior history. File remains open pending that response.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
